summary: NewHold Investment Corp IV filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on April 16, 2026, not a special situation. The offering consisted of 20,125,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $201.25M, plus a simultaneous private placement of 641,250 units to the sponsor and BTIG. Net proceeds were placed in a trust account. This is a routine SPAC IPO disclosure, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or management change.
